units.translation: ⟦1⟧ itself was found in A. in the ⟦2⟧ (Frg. 63): ⟦3⟧. ⟦4⟧ (Herm. for ⟦5⟧), where it apparently meant a locust. See ⟦6⟧ (after GHermann Opusc. V, 10 ff.). All this helps not in the least, and as transmitted, one must, with Dindorf, explain ⟦7⟧ as viridis seges and connect it (at least in A.'s sense) with ⟦8⟧. Hermann, following Fritzsche, wrote ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧; thus ⟦11⟧ becomes castration, as ⟦12⟧ in Homer was often explained as ⟦13⟧; hence also the scholia at our passage.
